title: Exploration of the interaction strength at the interface of neutral chalcogen ligands and gold surfaces
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4335-4346
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08118A, Paper
Open Access

Talia Alexandra Garzón, Mary Tabut, Monica Calatayud, Fernando Mendizabal, María Luisa Cerón
Using dispersion-corrected density functional theory (DFT-D3), this study examines the adsorption behavior of Au(XR) species (X = S, Se, Te; R = –H, –CH3, –C6H11) on five gold surfaces: Au(111), Au(100), Au(110), Au(321), and Au(32̄).
